messages:
jonah: FYI — I uploaded a compact roadmap sketch for the long-term platform topology and routing guardrails. Need feedback + alignment from Eng, Product, and Sales by EOW.

maria: Can you paste the launch criteria here? I want to align PM acceptance and sales commitments.

jonah: Sure — high level acceptance criteria (draft):
- SLOs: p99 token latency <= 120ms for 95% of traffic in primary region; tail guardrails in place for spikes.
- Error budget: <0.1% 5xx post-migration for 14 days.
- Quality: no regressions on the 3 canonical prompt suites; automatic rollback if chi-squared test flags >1% dev/regression.
- Cost: net cost per token change <= +10% vs baseline for the first 30 days, with optimization plan in place.
- Security/compliance: VPC + KMS paths validated for customer-tenanted routes.

anya: Quick clarification: is "tenant lane" equivalent to reserving a dedicated routing class + isolation pool, or is it logical (namespaces) only?

jonah: Good question — proposal splits it into two concepts:
1) Logical lanes: policy-level routing, affinity, and throttles. Cheap to create.
2) Isolation pools: physical or capacity-backed pools (Dedicated/GPU-isolated) that tenants can opt into. Migration moves tenants from logical lanes -> optional isolation pools.

samira: From Sales POV, enterprise customers want: dedicated pools + data-residency (EU-only) + encryption at rest. We need clear checklist before we tell customers timelines.

jonah: Agreed. Checklist itemized in the doc: required infra (EU region availability), KMS integration test, audit logs, SLA bump. We also add a migration policy template to each sales handoff.

kevin: On routing policies — are we planning to expose a DSL or a canned policy set? Customers will want easy presets + escape hatch.

jonah: Plan: ship canned presets first (latency-priority, cost-priority, residency, dedicated) + an internal DSL for advanced routing owners (eng-arch/infra) to author templates. Public DSL is Q3 follow-up if adoption warrants.

ops-bot: Document created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4129 (roadmap epic) :white_check_mark:

maria: Migration phases look reasonable. Can you list the pilot acceptance criteria? We need those to sign the pilot contract w/ customers.

jonah: Pilot (Phase 1) — target 2 anchor customers + 1 internal product:
- Pilot traffic <= 5% global; run for 14 days.
- Canary ramp: 1% -> 5% over 48h with automated rollback triggers on latency or error budget burn.
- Manual runbook for cross-region failover + tenant "quarantine" steps.
- Observability: per-tenant token-cost, p95/p99 latency dashboards, kv-cache hit rate.

samira: Add a billing delta template so Sales can estimate uplift for customers choosing isolation pools.

jonah: Noted — billing delta template + price band will be added to the epic.

anya: A couple of tradeoffs: prefix/KV caching is a win but complicates routing (shared caches across tenants increases blast radius). Proposal to scope cache-sharing rules into the policy layer. Thoughts?

kevin: Agree — add a cache-segmentation guideline: default is per-lane cache namespace; shared-cache allowed for same-tenant slices only.

jonah: Good call. I'll add explicit cache isolation recommendations with cost/latency tradeoffs.

maria: Timeline ask — can Eng commit to a Phase 1 pilot build in the next quarter? Need resource estimate.

jonah: Resource ask in doc: 3 engs (runtime + infra) x 8w + 1 SRE for runbooks + 1 PM/SE. That's optimistic but doable if we prioritize.

samira: We'll gate customer outreach until we have the pilot runbook + billing delta.

jonah: Action items:
- @anya: draft cache isolation section by Wed.
- @kevin: policy DSL vs presets doc sketch by Thu.
- @maria: customer acceptance template + billing delta by Fri.
- @samira: list candidate pilot customers (2) by EOW.
- @kevin/@ops-bot: create INF epic + child tasks (INF-4129 done, please add sub-tasks).

maria: I'll add legal + compliance to the checklist for EU-residency.

jonah: Final ask — react with :thumbsup: if you agree with the high-level plan, or reply with a single line objection if not. We will run a 30m sync Wednesday to finalize owners.

kevin: :thumbsup:
anya: :thumbsup:
samira: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Wednesday 10:00am — platform-topology sync.

jonah: Thanks team — I'll fold comments into the doc and push the updated checklist before EOD.
